listing.name: Skylanders: Swap Force — SwapForce-PC (AngelLopezTorres)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project’s 2026-10-23 result reaches boot videos, then uniform white output without effective game input or sound. USB portal self-tests do not establish game support. This is not ready for gameplay. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European English/German Xbox 360 Skylanders Swap Force XGD2 ISO of 8738846720 bytes. Game files and generated C++ or binaries are not included. Other source editions have not been confirmed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run setup.ps1 with your own ISO to extract it, decrypt the XEX and generate runtime/ppc_gen using the pinned XenonRecomp tools. Then build runtime/build/SwapForceRT.exe. This guide does not establish a published game-runtime package.

warnings: The project’s 2026-10-23 result reaches boot videos, then uniform white output without effective game input or sound. USB portal self-tests do not establish game support. This is not ready for gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
